note: Crosswalk between the 1830 source-pack roster and the existing Grand Century nations in the playable campaign seed. exclusiveAreaKm2 is the compiled polygon area left to a polity after the smallest-polygon-wins rule, on an equal-area sphere.

gcNationsWithoutLayerGeometry.reason: The Grand Duchy of Finland is held in personal union by the Russian emperor and lies inside the OHM Russian polygon; no separate exact-date relation was found.
The Hejaz is held by Egyptian forces on the Sultan's behalf (1813 to 1840) with the Sharif of Mecca subordinate to them; no separate geometry exists and the area lies inside the Ottoman polygon.
Outer Mongolia is administered by the Qing and lies inside the Qing polygon; no separate exact-date geometry exists.
Moldavia is an Ottoman tributary principality under Russian occupation, like Wallachia, but no exact-date OHM relation or Cliopatria polygon was found; the area lies inside the Ottoman polygon.
Wodeyar Mysore is a Company subsidiary state until direct Company administration in October 1831. No exact-date OHM or Cliopatria geometry exists; the area lies inside the Company Raj envelope.
The Orange Free State dates from 1854. In 1830 the region holds Griqua, Sotho and other polities without source geometry, so the area is uncovered.
Coastal Orissa has been Company territory since 1803 and the inland Garjat states are tributary chiefdoms; no Orissa polity exists on this date. The area lies inside the Company Raj envelope.
Tibet is a Qing protectorate under the ambans and lies inside the Qing polygon; no separate exact-date geometry exists.
The South African Republic dates from 1852. In 1830 the Highveld is Mzilikazi's Ndebele domain, for which no source geometry exists, so the area is uncovered.
